title: AdaptiveHoneypotEnv scripted episode: adaptive catch before compromise
goal_note: Observer-only script metadata. The defender never sees the private workflow goal label.
why: Real episodes run attacker agents against a live, Docker-contained SecretStorage service with real decoy credentials, and that trusted controller cannot safely run on a public static host. This page plays an illustrative scripted episode that follows the environment design while real runs are recorded and replayed separately.
reward_formula: r_t = 1[verified engagement before compromise] - 1[genuine compromise] - 0.02[newly committed decoys]
